Publication Notice

This issue could not be assembled

After rigorous review of research results available within the required editorial window of 31 October – 9 November 2026, the editors of THE SINGULARITY are unable to publish this issue. The sources identified either fall outside the verified date range, carry uncertain publication dates that cannot be confirmed against the issue date, or lack the specific factual detail — methodologies, findings, and demonstrated impact — necessary to report them with the accuracy this publication demands.

We hold that a science publication must never substitute speculation for evidence. Rather than publish incomplete or unverified content, this issue is respectfully left unproduced.
